alter.g: old (form of alt before a masculine noun)

aus.g: out of, from; looks like (sieht aus wie)

band.g: the ribbon she wraps around the stems

dabei.g: with me, on me (habe ich dabei); while doing it (schneidet dabei)

egal.g: of no importance (war ihr egal, she did not care)

erde.g: soil, the earth that plants grow in

glatte.g: smooth (form of glatt before a feminine noun)

her.g: back here (wieder her holen, to bring back)

lager.g: the depot where a dealer keeps her stock

leid.g: sorry (es tut mir leid, I am sorry)

liegt.g: lies, is lying somewhere; is (der Lohn liegt unter, the pay is below)

läuft.g: goes, works (so läuft das, that is how it works)

morgen.g: tomorrow (Morgen kommt dein Sofa); the morning (heute Morgen)

nehme.g: I take, I will take it (nehmen)

neue.g: new (form of neu before a feminine noun)

rechnung.g: the bill, what it will cost

schief.g: wrong, not as meant (kommt schief heraus)

stolz.g: pride, the feeling that makes asking for help hard

tut.g: does (es tut mir leid, I am sorry; tut weh, it hurts)

weg.g: away, gone (ist weg); the way through (den ganzen Weg)
